F&W Reports File Naming
A&R Prep = A&R order form # (it depends on the number)
To Pick and MISC:
File 1: To Pick
File 2: MISC Fisher & Woods 27.05.2026
Ifish Customer List = Ifish Order Form (as is on what is the file name in the google docs)
Reports Filtering
For A&R Prep
1. Filter start and end date to tom delivery
2. Hover down to Product groups and tick the box for Prepared
3. Once selected, hover down and go to Format choose CSV
4. Then click Generate Report
For To Pick (12 Midnight)
1. No need to filter dates, use as is
2. Hover down, go to Product Order Statuses and only tick 'To Pick'', untick the ''Supplied''
3. Then click Generate Report
4. Rename the file to "To Pick"
For MISC (12 Midnight)
1. No need to filter dates, use as is
2. Hover down, go to Product Groups and only tick "Ungrouped"
3. Then click Generate Report
4. Rename the file to "MISC Fisher & Woods 27.05.2026"
For Ifish (12 Midnight)
▶️ Don't forget to put the total number of page above in each sheet and marked all orders "FRESHO" in the notes.
